author: musho7-dev
subject: Production builds: test coins only in debug; deploy script release/fresh
body:
- TEST_MODE now follows the build type (OS.is_debug_build()): debug
  builds and Mac self-tests still top up to 1,000,000 coins, release
  builds never do, so the production version can't ship with free coins
- deploy-iphone.sh: "release" makes an optimized production build,
  "fresh" removes the old app and its save first
- Self-test "smart" driver kept for measuring difficulty

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
